title: Calendar export and controlled file trees
summary: React Big Calendar with explicit timed/all-day event rules, stable iCalendar generation, and React Arborist mutations that preserve identity and prevent cycles.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + React/ReactDOM 19.3.0; TypeScript build and four tests covering real ical-generator output across DST/all-day cases and Arborist move/index/tree invariants.
notes: React 18 is peer-compatible but unexecuted; browser calendar/tree keyboard, drag/drop and calendar-client import were not tested.
The calendar displays timed events in the browser local zone; recurrence expansion, remote calendar sync, availability checks and atomic persistence are application responsibilities.
